text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Clinging jealously to {0}, Eriko and Shizuru
continue their bitter struggle for romantic supremacy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}に抱きつき、
またも女同士の熾烈な戦いを繰り広げるエリコとシズル。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Now, my love, open wide...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
{0}様、
お口を開けて……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: You'd rather have your big sister's cooking, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは、
お姉ちゃんの料理の方がいいよね？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I don't think he can eat another bite!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
お兄ちゃんはお腹いっぱいなんですってばー！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... My perfect Eriko...
She's fawning over that man like a puppy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
あのエリコちゃんが
男に抱きついてうっとりしてる……！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
N-n-n-n-no, this is all wrong!
That's an illusion! Our weak minds are tricking us somehow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そそそそ、
そんなわけないだろう……
あれは幻覚だ！　
俺の弱い心が見せた幻なんだー！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Uh, listen. I only came here because I heard there'd be chocolate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうか、
今日チョコが食べられるって聞いたからここに来たのに！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
You promised free samples for everyone, didn't you?!
Hurry up and hand out the goods already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここに来たらチョコをタダでくれるって聞いたんだけど！
もう、
早く私たちにもチョコを配ってよ！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text:
I should've known... I was a fool to think a loser like me
could ever eat a girl's handmade chocolates...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃそうだよな……
俺なんかが
かわいい女の子の
作ったチョコレートを食べられるわけないし……

text_block_list.name: Man 4
text_block_list.text: At least declare a winner, for crying out loud!
text_block_list.orig_text: 料理対決の決着くらいつけろよーー！

text_block_list.name: Man 1 & Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Yeah, what gives?!
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだそうだ！

text_block_list.name: Man 2 & Woman 1
text_block_list.text: What's the big idea?!
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだそうだ！

text_block_list.name: Cacaola
text_block_list.text: *whiiiine*... *whiiiine*...
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅうううぅ……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Huh? Cally?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
カーくん！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with him?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたのかな？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: I don't know! He suddenly started crying...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かんない！　
急に苦しみ出して……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I have a rather bad feeling about this...
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだか嫌な予感がするのですが……

text_block_list.name: Woman 1 & 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaaghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあぁぁぁーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Aw, man! The whole stadium's ruined!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうっ！　
会場がめちゃくちゃだよ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: We have to keep the audience safe from the monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客さんに
魔物の攻撃が当たらないように気をつけて！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: We should stop it before the damage gets worse!
text_block_list.orig_text: 被害が大きくなる前に抑えましょう！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Big Bro, can you lend us your power?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん、
私たちの強化をお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: All right! Time for Big Sis to get serious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ～し、
お姉ちゃん、頑張っちゃうぞっ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: My love, please watch over me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}様、
見ていてくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Hahhh! Here I go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えいっ！　
行っくよ～！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Begone from my sight at once!
text_block_list.orig_text: 私の前から消え去りなさい。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Wait, why are you attacking at the same time as me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
なんで同じタイミングで攻撃しようとするの！？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: My dear Shizuru, kindly refrain from interrupting my assault.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シズルさんこそ、
譲り合いの精神というものに欠けてますわ。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Oh, for heaven's sake! Can't you two stop fighting for even a minute?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー二人とも、
こんな時までけんかしないでください！

text_block_list.name: Cacaola
text_block_list.text: *whiiiine*...
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅうううぅ……

text_block_list.name: Ugly Lovely
text_block_list.text: GRRUOOOOOGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Anyway, its body's so gloopy, our attacks aren't doing a thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大体、
身体がドロドロだから
攻撃が全然効かないですよぉ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Ngh... And I think it might be slowly growing stronger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クッ……
それに
少しづつ強くなってきているような……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Yes, a moment's hesitation could be fatal. Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
一瞬でも油断したら危ないですわね。
あっ！

text_block_list.name: Ugly Lovely
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Cacaola
text_block_list.text: Chocooo! Chocooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょこーっ、
ちょこっー！

text_block_list.name: Cacaola
text_block_list.text: Cuaahh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅうううぅ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Cally?!
text_block_list.orig_text: カーくんっ！？

text_block_list.name: Cacaola
text_block_list.text: *whiiiine*...
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅうううぅ……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: No way... He jumped in to protect us... But why...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
カーくんが私たちを守ろうとして……
どうして……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: How could you?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんてことをっ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I think he's just unconscious!
Li'l Bro, can you get this little guy to safety?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
気絶してるだけみたい。
弟くん、
急いでこの子を安全なところに隠してあげて。

text_block_list.name: Ugly Lovely
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That beast seems to be quite focused on the little one...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツ、
執拗にあの小さな魔物を狙っておりますわ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Well, it did come out of his cocoa pod, right?
There must be some connection.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もともとは
あの子のカカオから出てきたよね？
何か関係があるのかも。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text:
It's going to catch up with Big Bro!
Now it's my turn... I can't let that thing hurt Cally!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんが追いつかれちゃう！
今度は私が……
カーくんは、
私が守るんだから！

text_block_list.name: Ugly Lovely
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあああああっ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: H-huh? I'm... not hurt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？　
痛くない……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Oh my! My darling {0} shielded Rino with his body!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁっ、
{0}様がリノさんをかばいましたわ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Big Bro?! Why did you...
choice_data_list: I couldn't let Cally see you get hurt...
Cally's like family to you, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん！？　
どうして……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Even so...!
text_block_list.orig_text: だからって……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Family...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 家族……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: My love! Behind you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}様、
後ろっ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! The monster spat a strange liquid!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
あの魔物、
口から液体を！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: It's glued Big Bro to the floor?!
text_block_list.orig_text: お兄ちゃんが捕まっちゃったっ！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With {0} taken hostage by the monster,
will his friends and Valentines be able to turn the situation around?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物に捕まり人質にされてしまった{0}。
シズルたちはこの状況を打開することができるのか。
